今日のごはん🍚

朝ごはんは、朝食バイキング。

お昼ごはんは、象潟うどん。
朝食べ過ぎたので、昼は軽め(？)

道中の笹川流れの塩工房で塩ソフト食べたり、鼠ヶ関の側の道の駅で焼きイカ食べたり、今日は常に腹が満たされてた( ´)Д(｀)

item.title: Jake the cat has a face full of hope. It’s a mystery to me …
item.author: film-authority.com (@film-authority.bsky.social)
item.description:
Jake the cat has a face full of hope.

It’s a mystery to me what cats think and remember, but it seems to me that we can learn a lot from how hopeful they are. Here’s wee Jake, he really doesn’t ask for much out of life, but seems happy just to rest his head on my pyjamas.

Happy #caturday y’all!!
